content.text:
I found 15 arts and holiday events in Hanover between November 19, 2026 and May 18, 2027. Most come from official Dartmouth, Hopkins Center ("the Hop") and Town of Hanover pages. None are reported cancelled or postponed. Many Hop listings give dates but no times, so I've noted where a time is missing. Some Hop pages are shared across events and their excerpts list several dates in one place; a few findings below rely on that kind of listing.
